prompt: The new policy allows students to borrow books, to reserve study rooms, and ___ laptops for three days.
explanation: Daftar paralel memakai pola yang sama, yaitu to borrow, to reserve, dan to rent.

prompt: The lecturer was known for being organized, patient, and ___ to every student's questions.
explanation: Organized dan patient adalah adjektif, sehingga bagian ketiga juga harus adjektif responsive yang diikuti to.

prompt: The speaker's argument was too ___ for a general audience, so she used simple examples from daily life.
explanation: Technical berarti sangat khusus atau rumit, sehingga pembicara memakai contoh sederhana agar audiens umum mengerti.

prompt: To confirm the main idea, read the topic sentence first, then ___ the rest of the paragraph for supporting details.
explanation: Scan berarti mencari informasi tertentu dengan cepat, misalnya contoh pendukung dalam paragraf.

prompt: Kami menyusun daftar kegiatan dengan bentuk kata kerja yang sejajar.
acceptedAnswers: We arranged the list of activities with parallel verb forms.
We organized the list of activities using parallel verb forms.
explanation: Parallel verb forms adalah istilah tata bahasa untuk bentuk kata kerja yang berpola sama dalam sebuah daftar.

prompt: Penjelasan dosen itu singkat, jelas, dan mudah diikuti.
acceptedAnswers: The lecturer's explanation was short, clear, and easy to follow.
The explanation from the lecturer was brief, clear, and easy to follow.
explanation: Tiga adjektif disusun sejajar dengan koma, dan easy to follow adalah ungkapan wajar untuk penjelasan yang mudah dipahami.

passage: Yusuf needed to prepare a short report on urban gardens for his environmental course. The assigned article was fourteen pages long, and he had only one afternoon to finish the reading. Instead of starting from the first line, he looked at the title, the subheadings, and the summary box at the end. This quick preview told him that the article compared rooftop farms with community gardens in three cities. After that, he skimmed each section to understand the main argument. When he needed the number of participants in one study, he scanned the page for digits and found the figure in the third section. By evening, he had enough information for his report, and he had not read every word.
prompt: Apa langkah pertama Yusuf sebelum membaca isi artikel secara lebih teliti?

options.text: Menerjemahkan setiap paragraf ke bahasa Indonesia
Membaca judul, subjudul, dan ringkasan secara sekilas
Menghafal semua angka yang ada di dalam artikel

explanation: Yusuf memeriksa judul, subjudul, dan ringkasan terlebih dahulu sebagai pratinjau sebelum membaca lebih detail.

script: Let's look at a sentence from a student's essay: 'The city council wants to build parks, to improve drainage, and planting more trees.' The sentence has a clear problem. The first two items use the infinitive, but the last item switches to an -ing form. To fix it, the writer should say 'to plant more trees' so that all three items follow the same pattern.
prompt: Apa masalah utama pada kalimat dari esai mahasiswa tersebut?

options.text: The sentence uses too many commas.
The last item does not match the infinitive pattern of the others.
The city council is named incorrectly.
The sentence has no main verb.

explanation: Daftar paralel harus memakai pola yang sama; di sini item terakhir berubah menjadi planting, bukan to plant.

prompt: Susun ulang kata menjadi kalimat bahasa Inggris (arti: Mahasiswa itu membaca sekilas daftar isi sebelum memilih bab)
acceptedAnswers: The student skimmed the table of contents before choosing a chapter
explanation: Skimmed adalah bentuk lampau dari skim, dan kata before diikuti bentuk -ing seperti choosing.

prompt: I wish the library ___ open late on Fridays, because I always finish my shift at night.
explanation: Setelah I wish, keadaan yang tidak nyata di masa kini memakai bentuk past subjunctive were.

prompt: Not only ___ the question quickly, but she also explained each step clearly.
explanation: Setelah Not only di awal kalimat, subjek dan kata bantu harus dibalik menjadi did she answer.

prompt: The waiter ___ the complaint with a sincere apology and offered a free dessert to the family.
explanation: Acknowledged berarti mengakui atau menerima keluhan, sesuai dengan permintaan maaf yang tulus.

prompt: Rina had to ___ the meeting until Friday because her train was delayed on Monday.
explanation: Reschedule berarti mengubah jadwal ke waktu lain, sesuai dengan keterlambatan kereta.

prompt: Saya kurang setuju dengan usulanmu, tetapi saya menghargai niat baikmu.
acceptedAnswers: I do not fully agree with your suggestion, but I appreciate your good intention.
I do not completely agree with your idea, but I appreciate your good intentions.
explanation: Kurang setuju dapat diterjemahkan sebagai do not fully agree, sedangkan menghargai niat baik adalah appreciate your good intention.

prompt: Maaf, bisakah Anda mengulang nomor tiketnya, karena suara di telepon kurang jelas?
acceptedAnswers: Sorry, could you repeat the ticket number, because the voice on the phone is unclear?
Excuse me, could you repeat the ticket number because the line is not clear?
explanation: Could you repeat adalah bentuk sopan untuk meminta pengulangan, dan unclear dipakai untuk suara yang sulit didengar.

passage: Maya visited the registration office on Monday to ask for an extension on her tuition payment. The staff member at the counter listened carefully, then checked the system. He explained that the office could not change the due date, but it could allow a payment plan for two weeks. Maya said she was worried because her scholarship letter had not arrived yet. The staff member replied that she should bring the letter to the office as soon as it came, and he wrote a reference number on a small card. Before she left, he suggested that she also email the finance department, because they could confirm the scholarship status.
prompt: Apa saran yang diberikan petugas ketika Maya khawatir tentang surat beasiswanya?

options.text: Membawa surat beasiswa ke kantor begitu surat itu tiba

explanation: Ketika Maya menyebut kekhawatirannya, petugas menyarankan agar ia membawa surat beasiswa ke kantor segera setelah surat itu tiba.

script: Student: Hi, I reserved the lab room for Thursday, but it does not show up in the system. Staff: Yes, your booking was canceled automatically because the form was not signed. Student: I did not know that. Can I still use the room this week? Staff: Yes, if you sign the form today, I can rebook it for Friday afternoon.
prompt: Apa yang harus dilakukan mahasiswa agar bisa tetap memakai ruang lab?

options.text: Book a different room for Thursday
Sign the form today so the room can be rebooked
Ask the staff to cancel the Friday booking
Wait until next week for a new form

explanation: Staf menjelaskan bahwa pemesanan dibatalkan karena formulir belum ditandatangani, dan ruang bisa dipesan ulang jika formulir ditandatangani hari itu.

prompt: Susun ulang kata menjadi kalimat bahasa Inggris (arti: Saya akan memeriksa jadwal ruang itu lagi sebelum mengirim email)
acceptedAnswers: I will check the room schedule again before I send the email
explanation: Kata again berarti lagi, dan urutan before I send mengikuti pola subjek lalu kata kerja.

prompt: A paraphrase must ___ the original idea, even though the words and sentence structure are different.
explanation: Setelah modal must, kata kerja memakai bentuk dasar, yaitu preserve.

prompt: Had the writer ___ the source clearly, the editor would not have flagged the paragraph as copied.
explanation: Pada kalimat pengandaian dengan inversi Had, dipakai bentuk past participle credited.

prompt: The editor asked the writer to ___ the second paragraph, because it repeated the same point three times.
explanation: Trim berarti memangkas bagian yang berlebihan agar tulisan lebih ringkas.

prompt: 'Enormous' and 'huge' are ___ in this context, because both describe something of great size.
explanation: Sinonim adalah kata dengan makna yang mirip; antonim berlawanan, homonim sama bunyi atau ejaannya, dan akronim disingkat dari huruf awal.

prompt: Parafrasa yang baik tetap menjaga makna asli meskipun susunan katanya berbeda.
acceptedAnswers: A good paraphrase keeps the original meaning even though its wording is different.
A good paraphrase preserves the original meaning even when the wording is different.
explanation: Keeps atau preserves the original meaning berarti menjaga makna asli, sedangkan wording merujuk pada pilihan kata.

prompt: Ringkasan itu menghilangkan contoh, tetapi kesimpulan utamanya tidak berubah.
acceptedAnswers: The summary leaves out the examples, but its main conclusion does not change.
The summary omits the examples, yet its main conclusion stays the same.
explanation: Leaves out dan omits sama-sama berarti menghilangkan, dan does not change atau stays the same menyatakan bahwa kesimpulan tetap.

passage: A biology professor wrote a short claim in her lecture notes: 'Plants in shaded forests grow more slowly than plants in open fields.' Two students were asked to paraphrase it for a summary. Dewi wrote, 'Forest plants develop at a slower rate than plants that receive direct sunlight.' Rafi wrote, 'Plants in forests are weak, while field plants are strong.' His version changed the meaning, because the professor only said that growth was slower, not that the plants were weak. The teacher marked Dewi's sentence as accurate and asked Rafi to revise his claim. She explained that a good paraphrase must keep the idea identical, not simply swap words while adding a new claim.
prompt: Mengapa parafrasa Rafi dianggap kurang tepat?

options.text: Karena ia menggunakan kata yang terlalu panjang
Karena ia menambahkan klaim bahwa tanaman itu lemah
Karena ia tidak menyebut nama profesor
Karena ia menulis dalam bentuk pertanyaan

explanation: Rafi menambahkan klaim bahwa tanaman itu lemah, padahal sumber hanya menyatakan pertumbuhannya lebih lambat.

script: In today's lecture, I want to show you how a paraphrase can go wrong. The original sentence says that the team 'collected samples' from three rivers. One student wrote that the team 'gathered specimens' from three rivers, which is a fair paraphrase. Another student wrote that the team 'tested the rivers in all seasons,' which adds a new detail not found in the source. A good paraphrase should not add or remove the main claim.
prompt: Mengapa parafrasa kedua disebut bermasalah menurut dosen?

options.text: It uses the word specimens, which is too technical.
It adds a detail that was not in the original sentence.
It changes the number of rivers in the claim.
It repeats the original sentence exactly.

explanation: Dosen menjelaskan bahwa parafrasa kedua menambahkan detail baru yang tidak ada di kalimat sumber.

prompt: Susun ulang kata menjadi kalimat bahasa Inggris (arti: Sinonim yang tepat membantu penulis menghindari pengulangan kata yang sama)
acceptedAnswers: Accurate synonyms help the writer avoid repeating the same word
explanation: Help diikuti kata kerja dasar avoid, dan repeating adalah bentuk -ing setelah avoid.

prompt: The students had ___ the chapter three times before the exam, so they felt confident during the test.
explanation: Setelah had dipakai past participle, dan bentuk read pada posisi ini tetap ditulis sama seperti bentuk kini.

prompt: Ever since she joined the debate club, she ___ more confident when speaking in public.
explanation: Ever since dengan keadaan yang masih berlanjut memakai present perfect, yaitu has felt.

prompt: Because the report is due tomorrow morning, we will have to ___ and finish the draft after midnight.
explanation: Burn the midnight oil adalah idiom yang berarti bekerja atau belajar sampai larut malam.

prompt: Our group still has no plan, so let's ___ by making a list of tasks for each member.
explanation: Get the ball rolling berarti memulai sesuatu, sedangkan miss the boat berarti terlambat dan under the weather berarti kurang sehat.

prompt: Dia sedang tidak enak badan, jadi dia memilih tinggal di rumah.
acceptedAnswers: She is under the weather, so she decided to stay at home.
She is feeling under the weather, so she chose to stay home.
explanation: Under the weather adalah idiom untuk merasa kurang sehat, sedangkan memilih tinggal di rumah diterjemahkan sebagai decided to stay at home.

prompt: Jangan khawatir, kita pasti bisa melewati masalah ini bersama-sama.
acceptedAnswers: Do not worry, we will pull through this problem together.
Do not worry, we will get through this problem together.
explanation: Pull through berarti berhasil melewati situasi sulit, dan together berarti bersama-sama.

passage: At the language club, Lina and her friends had a game. Every member had to use an English idiom in a sentence before the meeting ended. Tomas started with 'piece of cake,' which he used when he talked about an easy exam. Lina tried 'cut corners' when she described a classmate who finished a project too quickly and skipped important steps. The leader of the club smiled and explained that the phrase meant doing something carelessly to save time or money. At the end of the meeting, everyone agreed that a short list of idioms was easier to remember than a long textbook chapter.
prompt: Menurut paragraf, apa arti ungkapan 'cut corners'?

options.text: Bekerja dengan teliti untuk mendapat hasil terbaik
Melakukan sesuatu dengan ceroboh demi menghemat waktu atau biaya

explanation: Paragraf menjelaskan bahwa cut corners berarti bertindak ceroboh untuk menghemat waktu atau biaya.

script: Hey, I know you asked me to join the study group on Saturday, but I have a lot on my plate this week. My project is due Monday, and I still need to finish two chapters. Could we move the session to next Thursday instead? I would really appreciate that.
prompt: Apa maksud ungkapan 'a lot on my plate' dalam percakapan ini?

options.text: The speaker has many tasks to handle
The speaker wants to eat dinner together
The speaker has broken a plate
The speaker is planning a trip next week

explanation: Have a lot on my plate adalah idiom yang berarti memiliki banyak pekerjaan atau tanggung jawab.

prompt: Susun ulang kata menjadi kalimat bahasa Inggris (arti: Dia sedang banyak pekerjaan jadi dia belum bisa membantu kami)
acceptedAnswers: She has a lot on her plate so she cannot help us yet
explanation: A lot on her plate adalah idiom untuk banyak pekerjaan, dan cannot help us yet menyatakan belum bisa membantu.

prompt: Rarely ___ the library so crowded during finals week, which is why students arrive early.
explanation: Rarely di awal kalimat membalik urutan menjadi does the library become, dengan kata kerja dasar setelah does.

prompt: No sooner ___ the bus left the station than the rain started falling.
explanation: Pola No sooner dengan inversi memakai past perfect, sehingga yang benar adalah had.

prompt: The project ___ after the funding was cut, and the team could not continue the work.
explanation: Collapsed berarti gagal atau runtuh; dalam konteks ini proyek tidak bisa berlanjut setelah dana dipotong.

prompt: The applicant was ___ for the job because he did not have the required certificate.
explanation: Rejected berarti ditolak, yang sesuai karena sertifikat wajib tidak dimiliki pelamar.

prompt: Dia tidak punya cukup waktu untuk menyelesaikan tugas itu dengan baik.
acceptedAnswers: He does not have enough time to finish the task well.
He lacks sufficient time to complete the task properly.
explanation: Lacks dipakai untuk menyatakan kekurangan, sedangkan does not have enough time adalah bentuk negatif yang lebih umum.

prompt: Tidak ada seorang pun yang mengetahui alasan pembatalan konser itu.
acceptedAnswers: Nobody knew the reason for the cancellation of the concert.
No one knew the reason why the concert was canceled.
explanation: Nobody dan no one adalah kata ganti negatif untuk seseorang, dan cancellation adalah kata benda dari cancel.

passage: The Lintang River Volunteers planned a clean-up day for the first Saturday of March. They had gathered more than sixty people, rented two small boats, and bought gloves and bags. However, a week before the event, the city office said that the group could not enter the river area without a formal permit. The volunteers were disappointed, because the permit process usually takes at least a month. One member said that without the boats, they would be unable to collect the heavy waste in the middle of the river. After a long discussion, the group decided to postpone the river work and focus on the nearby park for now.
prompt: Mengapa rencana membersihkan sungai harus ditunda?

options.text: Karena relawan tidak memiliki sarung tangan
Karena kelompok belum memiliki izin resmi untuk masuk ke area sungai
Karena cuaca di bulan Maret terlalu panas
Karena jumlah relawan kurang dari sepuluh orang

explanation: Kantor kota menyatakan kelompok tidak boleh masuk ke area sungai tanpa izin resmi, sehingga kegiatan di sungai ditunda.

script: Hello, this is the campus clinic. We are sorry, but the vaccination session on Wednesday is unlikely to take place because the nurse on duty is unable to attend. Students who have already registered should not come to the clinic that day. We will not be able to offer walk-in service either. Please check our website for a new date, and call us if you have any questions.
prompt: Apa yang harus dilakukan mahasiswa yang sudah mendaftar untuk sesi hari Rabu?

options.text: Come to the clinic on Wednesday as planned
Wait for a nurse at the clinic desk
Check the website for a new date instead of coming that day
Call the clinic to request a walk-in visit

explanation: Pengumuman meminta mahasiswa tidak datang pada hari Rabu dan memeriksa website untuk tanggal baru.

prompt: Susun ulang kata menjadi kalimat bahasa Inggris (arti: Mahasiswa yang ingin loker harus menandatangani buku pendaftaran lebih dulu)
acceptedAnswers: Students who want a locker must sign the register first
explanation: Who want a locker adalah klausa relatif, sedangkan must sign the register first menyatakan kewajiban yang dilakukan lebih dulu.

prompt: I would have attended the orientation if I ___ about the date earlier in the week.
explanation: Pengandaian masa lampau memakai past perfect pada klausa if, yaitu had known.

prompt: The scholarship, ___ to students with high grades, covers the full tuition fee for one year.
explanation: Bentuk awarded adalah participle pasif yang menjelaskan scholarship, yaitu beasiswa yang diberikan kepada mahasiswa berprestasi.

prompt: Students who want to change their major must submit a formal ___ to the department before the end of September.
explanation: Petition berarti surat permohonan resmi, yang tepat untuk meminta perubahan program studi.

prompt: The writing ___ on the second floor offers free feedback on essays every weekday morning.
explanation: Writing center adalah pusat layanan bantuan menulis di kampus, sehingga kata benda center paling tepat.

prompt: Jadwal kelas saya berubah setelah dosen pembimbing menyetujui perubahan mata kuliah.
acceptedAnswers: My class schedule changed after the academic advisor approved the course change.
My class schedule was changed after my advisor approved the change of courses.
explanation: Academic advisor adalah dosen pembimbing akademik, sedangkan approved the course change berarti menyetujui perubahan mata kuliah.

prompt: Mahasiswa baru diwajibkan mengikuti pengenalan kampus sebelum mendaftar kelas.
acceptedAnswers: New students are required to attend the campus orientation before registering for classes.
New students must attend campus orientation before they register for classes.
explanation: Are required to attend menyatakan kewajiban dalam bentuk pasif, dan before registering memakai bentuk -ing setelah before.

passage: Dina had her first week of classes at a large university, and she felt lost. On Tuesday, she realized that her timetable had two courses at the same hour. She went to the student services desk, where a clerk asked for her student number and checked the schedule on the computer. The clerk explained that she could not keep both courses, but she could move one of them to the next semester if the course had an open seat. He also told her that the change needed the signature of her academic advisor before it became official.
prompt: Apa yang harus dilakukan Dina agar perubahan jadwalnya menjadi resmi?

options.text: Membayar biaya tambahan di kantor keuangan
Mendapatkan tanda tangan dari dosen pembimbing akademiknya
Meminta temannya mengambil kelas itu untuknya

explanation: Petugas menjelaskan bahwa perubahan jadwal baru resmi setelah ditandatangani oleh dosen pembimbing akademik.

script: Hi, this is Ferdi from the residence office. The dining hall is open for breakfast from six thirty to nine on weekdays, and from seven to ten on weekends. Lunch service begins at eleven, but on Saturdays it closes earlier, at two in the afternoon. If you plan to join the cooking workshop, please register online by Thursday evening. The workshop itself is on Saturday at four.
prompt: Menurut pengumuman, jam berapa layanan makan siang berakhir pada hari Sabtu?
explanation: Pengumuman menyebut layanan makan siang pada hari Sabtu lebih awal berakhir, yaitu pukul dua siang.

prompt: Susun ulang kata menjadi kalimat bahasa Inggris (arti: Kartu mahasiswa baru bisa diambil di loket utama setelah pembayaran selesai)
acceptedAnswers: New student cards can be collected at the main counter after the payment is completed
explanation: Can be collected adalah bentuk pasif modal, dan after the payment is completed menyatakan urutan waktu.

prompt: If the first results had been unreliable, the researchers ___ the sample again before publishing.
explanation: Pengandaian masa lampau dengan had been memakai would have plus past participle, yaitu would have tested.

prompt: The theory, ___ by three different teams, predicted the result accurately in every trial.
explanation: Bentuk tested adalah participle pasif yang menjelaskan theory, yaitu teori yang telah diuji oleh tiga tim.

prompt: A ___ is a clear statement about what a researcher expects to find before collecting data.
explanation: Hypothesis adalah dugaan yang dapat diuji, sedangkan citation adalah rujukan, appendix adalah lampiran, dan index adalah daftar kata kunci.

prompt: The team had to ___ its findings with caution, because the sample included only forty participants.
explanation: Interpret berarti menafsirkan, dan kehati-hatian diperlukan karena jumlah sampelnya kecil.

prompt: Teori ini masih perlu diuji karena data yang tersedia belum cukup.
acceptedAnswers: This theory still needs to be tested because the available data is not enough yet.
This theory still needs testing because there is not enough data yet.
explanation: Needs to be tested dan needs testing sama-sama menyatakan kebutuhan pengujian dalam bentuk pasif.

prompt: Peneliti mengumpulkan data dari seratus responden di tiga kota berbeda.
acceptedAnswers: The researchers collected data from one hundred respondents in three different cities.
The researchers gathered data from a hundred respondents in three different cities.
explanation: Respondents berarti responden, yaitu orang yang memberi jawaban; collected dan gathered sama-sama berarti mengumpulkan.

passage: A nutrition team wanted to know whether breakfast affects test scores in middle school. Their main hypothesis was that students who eat breakfast perform better in morning exams. To test this idea, they selected two groups of students with similar ages and grades. The first group ate breakfast at home before school, while the second group skipped breakfast on the test days. They called the breakfast condition the independent variable, because the team changed it on purpose. The exam score was the dependent variable, because it depended on that condition. The report was published with clear notes about the sample size, which made it easier for other scientists to repeat the study.
prompt: Dalam penelitian ini, apa yang disebut variabel terikat?
explanation: Nilai ujian bergantung pada kondisi sarapan, sehingga nilai ujian merupakan variabel terikat.

script: Today I want to explain why a sample must represent the population. Imagine a survey about study habits that includes only students from the engineering department. The results may look useful, but they cannot describe the whole university. A sample with mixed departments gives a more accurate picture. That does not mean every department must be equal in size, but the important groups should be included.
prompt: Mengapa pembicara menganggap sampel dari berbagai jurusan lebih baik?

options.text: Because the engineering students have the best grades
Because a survey must always include every student in the university
Because a mixed sample gives a more accurate picture of the population
Because the results of the survey can be guessed in advance

explanation: Pembicara menjelaskan bahwa sampel campuran memberi gambaran populasi yang lebih akurat dibanding hanya satu jurusan.

prompt: Susun ulang kata menjadi kalimat bahasa Inggris (arti: Setiap hipotesis harus bisa diuji dengan data yang nyata)
acceptedAnswers: Every hypothesis must be testable with real data
explanation: Testable berarti dapat diuji, dan must menyatakan keharusan dalam pernyataan ilmiah.

prompt: By next semester, I ___ all the required courses if I keep this pace of studying.
explanation: Future perfect menyatakan sesuatu yang sudah selesai pada titik waktu tertentu di masa depan, yaitu will have finished.

prompt: The coordinator asked that the rooms ___ before noon on Monday so the seminar could begin on time.
explanation: Setelah kata kerja permintaan asked that, dipakai bentuk dasar pasif be cleaned.

prompt: Her explanation was so ___ that the whole class could follow every step of the proof.
explanation: Lucid berarti jelas dan mudah dipahami, sesuai dengan kemampuan kelas mengikuti setiap langkah.

prompt: The two departments had a ___ about who should pay for the new lab equipment.
explanation: Dispute berarti perselisihan, yang sesuai dengan pertengkaran dua departemen tentang biaya.

prompt: Jika kamu terlambat, tolong beri tahu dosen sebelum kelas dimulai.
acceptedAnswers: If you are late, please let the lecturer know before class begins.
If you will be late, please inform the lecturer before the class starts.
explanation: Let someone know berarti memberi tahu seseorang, dan before class begins adalah ungkapan waktu yang wajar.

prompt: Hasil diskusi kelompok kami belum final, jadi kami akan membahasnya lagi besok.
acceptedAnswers: Our group discussion results are not final yet, so we will talk about them again tomorrow.
The results of our group discussion are not final, so we will discuss them again tomorrow.
explanation: Not final yet berarti belum final, dan discuss them again berarti membahasnya kembali.

passage: Rama and Fitri were assigned to the same group project, but they could not agree on a timetable. Rama wanted to meet every evening, because he worked in the afternoon and had free time only after dinner. Fitri preferred weekends, since she had three classes each weekday and needed rest. The tension grew during the second meeting, when neither of them wanted to change their plan. Their lecturer, Mrs. Hadi, offered to act as a neutral mediator. She asked each student to write one reason for their proposal and one flexible option they could accept. After reading both notes, she suggested a compromise: two short meetings on weekdays, followed by one longer session on Saturday.
prompt: Apa peran Ibu Hadi dalam perselisihan kelompok tersebut?

options.text: Menjadi pihak netral dan membantu mencari kompromi
Memilih jadwal yang paling disukai Rama

explanation: Ibu Hadi menawarkan diri sebagai penengah netral dan mengusulkan kompromi yang diterima kedua mahasiswa.

script: Hi, this is the teaching assistant for the chemistry lab. The Tuesday session has been canceled because the room is under maintenance. You will not be able to use the lab until Thursday, but the report deadline remains the same. If you need extra help, the office hours on Wednesday afternoon are still open. Please bring your questions written on paper, because the office does not have a projector.
prompt: Apa yang tetap tidak berubah meskipun praktikum hari Selasa dibatalkan?

options.text: The lab will reopen on Tuesday
The report deadline remains the same
The office hours on Wednesday are canceled
Students must print their questions in color

explanation: Asisten menyebut tenggat laporan tetap sama meskipun sesi praktikum hari Selasa dibatalkan.

prompt: Susun ulang kata menjadi kalimat bahasa Inggris (arti: Dosen itu meminta kami menyerahkan ringkasan sebelum siang)
acceptedAnswers: The lecturer asked us to submit the summary before noon
explanation: Asked us to submit menyatakan permintaan, dan before noon berarti sebelum siang.

prompt: Had the candidates ___ the instructions carefully, they would have avoided the mistake in the first section.
explanation: Inversi pengandaian dengan Had memakai past participle, yaitu read, setelah subjek candidates.

prompt: Neither the audio clips nor the reading passage ___ extra time, so every candidate must follow the timer.
explanation: Pada pola neither-nor, kata kerja mengikuti subjek yang paling dekat, yaitu passage yang tunggal, sehingga digunakan is.

prompt: The test center sent a detailed ___ listing the rules, the timing, and the check-in procedure.
explanation: Guide berarti panduan, dan dalam konteks ini dokumen tersebut berisi aturan serta prosedur ujian.

prompt: He had to ___ his time carefully so that he could finish all three sections before the bell rang.
explanation: Allocate berarti membagi atau menyediakan waktu untuk setiap bagian.

prompt: Peserta yang sudah selesai boleh memeriksa jawaban mereka, tetapi tidak boleh berbicara dengan peserta lain.
acceptedAnswers: Participants who have finished may review their answers, but they must not talk to other participants.
Candidates who finish early may check their answers, but they cannot speak to other candidates.
explanation: May review menyatakan izin, sedangkan must not talk menyatakan larangan.

prompt: Pengawas ujian mengingatkan bahwa ponsel harus dimatikan sebelum sesi dimulai.
acceptedAnswers: The proctor reminded everyone that mobile phones must be turned off before the session begins.
The invigilator reminded us that phones must be switched off before the session starts.
explanation: Proctor dan invigilator sama-sama berarti pengawas ujian, sedangkan must be turned off menyatakan keharusan dalam bentuk pasif.

passage: Lestari practiced with a timer every Saturday for a month. At first, she spent too long on difficult sentence questions and rushed through the last part of each set. Her tutor advised her to mark any item that took more than one minute, then return to it after finishing the easier ones. Lestari tried this method during her next practice test. She skipped a complicated question about sentence order, marked it with a small symbol, and kept moving. When she reached the end of the set, she still had three minutes left, so she solved the marked item calmly. Her score improved by eight points, but more importantly, she no longer panicked when she saw a hard question.
prompt: Mengapa Lestari menandai soal yang sulit dan melewatinya terlebih dahulu?

options.text: Agar ia bisa menjawab soal mudah lebih dulu dan menjaga waktunya
Agar tutornya dapat memeriksa jawabannya lebih cepat
Karena ia ingin mengulang seluruh latihan dari awal
Karena soal itu sudah dijawab oleh temannya

explanation: Tutor menyarankan agar soal yang memakan waktu lama ditandai dan dikerjakan kembali setelah soal yang lebih mudah selesai.

script: Please take out your pencil and place your identification card on the desk. The first audio track will play only once, so listen carefully to the speaker. Do not turn to the next page until I tell you to start. If you have a question about the rules, raise your hand now, before the recording begins, and I will answer it quietly.
prompt: Menurut pengawas, kapan peserta boleh mengangkat tangan untuk bertanya?

options.text: During the recording, when the audio is playing
Only after the whole test has ended

explanation: Pengawas meminta peserta bertanya sebelum rekaman dimulai, bukan selama rekaman berlangsung.

prompt: Susun ulang kata menjadi kalimat bahasa Inggris (arti: Setiap peserta harus duduk di nomor kursi yang tertera pada kartu)
acceptedAnswers: Each participant must sit in the seat number printed on the card
explanation: Printed on the card adalah frasa yang menjelaskan nomor kursi, dan must sit menyatakan keharusan.

prompt: My reading score ___ by nearly ten points since the last simulation, which encourages me to keep going.
explanation: Since the last simulation menunjukkan kejadian dari masa lalu sampai sekarang, sehingga digunakan present perfect has increased.

prompt: I wish I ___ more practice tests before the first simulation, because I would have felt calmer.
explanation: Penyesalan tentang masa lalu memakai I wish dengan past perfect, yaitu had taken.

prompt: Her practice notes are very ___: every mistake is recorded together with its reason and the correct fix.
explanation: Thorough berarti teliti dan lengkap, sesuai dengan catatan yang mencantumkan setiap kesalahan beserta penyebabnya.

prompt: After the mock test, the instructor ___ the results so that each student could see the weak areas clearly.
explanation: Analyzed berarti menganalisis, dan dalam konteks ini instruktur memeriksa hasil untuk menunjukkan bagian yang lemah.

prompt: Saya ingin meningkatkan kecepatan membaca tanpa mengorbankan ketelitian.
acceptedAnswers: I want to improve my reading speed without sacrificing accuracy.
I would like to increase my reading speed without losing accuracy.
explanation: Without sacrificing accuracy berarti tanpa mengorbankan ketelitian, sedangkan improve dan increase sama-sama bisa dipakai untuk meningkatkan.

prompt: Target skor saya tahun ini adalah mencapai nilai yang cukup untuk pendaftaran beasiswa.
acceptedAnswers: My target this year is to reach a score high enough for the scholarship application.
This year, my goal is to get a score that is high enough for the scholarship application.
explanation: High enough for berarti cukup tinggi untuk, dan scholarship application berarti pendaftaran beasiswa.

passage: Nadia completed three full simulations in two months. After each one, she wrote a short note about the section that caused the most trouble. In the first simulation, the listening section took too much of her attention, and she missed several details about dates and places. In the third simulation, she was faster in the reading section, but she still struggled with the final three questions in the structure section. She compared her results in a simple table and noticed that her accuracy had improved more than her speed. Nadia decided that her next step would be timed structure drills twice a week, while keeping her listening practice steady.
prompt: Apa kesimpulan Nadia tentang kemajuannya setelah tiga simulasi?

options.text: Ketelitiannya meningkat lebih banyak daripada kecepatannya
Kecepatannya meningkat jauh lebih besar daripada ketelitiannya
Ia sama sekali tidak meningkat dalam bagian listening
Ia memutuskan berhenti berlatih bagian structure

explanation: Nadia membandingkan hasilnya dan menyimpulkan bahwa ketelitian jawabannya membaik lebih banyak daripada kecepatannya.

script: Let's talk about your next target. You should aim to finish the reading section with at least two minutes to spare. Try practicing with a timer twice a week, but keep your review session short and focused. After each test, circle the questions you guessed, even if your answer turned out to be correct. Those guessed questions often show the topics that need more work.
prompt: Apa yang disarankan pembicara setelah setiap tes latihan?

options.text: Throw away the questions that were answered correctly
Circle the guessed questions, even the correct ones
Skip the review and focus only on new tests
Finish the test twice in the same day

explanation: Pembicara menyarankan menandai soal yang ditebak, termasuk yang jawabannya benar, karena soal itu menunjukkan topik yang perlu diperkuat.

prompt: Susun ulang kata menjadi kalimat bahasa Inggris (arti: Saya mencatat setiap kesalahan agar tidak mengulanginya di simulasi berikutnya)
acceptedAnswers: I record every mistake so that I do not repeat it in the next simulation
explanation: So that menyatakan tujuan, dan do not repeat it berarti tidak mengulanginya.
